name: Molly
source:
Molly has always tried to be a good girl. Yet no matter what she does, she has never been able to win the affection of her older siblings.

But she'll keep trying.

She has to.

[From [url=https://sunlit-dreamer.itch.io/molly]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莫莉一直努力做一个好女孩。但无论她做什么，始终无法赢得哥哥姐姐们的喜爱。

但她会继续努力。

她必须这么做。

[来自[url=https://sunlit-dreamer.itch.io/molly]Itch.io[/url]]
